verdict.rationale: There's evidence of API-level access (API key support, OpenAI REST API OpenAPI spec, multi-language API reference with code samples, MCP JSON-RPC interface for programmatic control) suggesting Codex/OpenAI can be built against via official SDKs. However, this evidence is mostly about the general OpenAI platform API rather than a Codex-specific SDK, and community evidence notes the actual gpt-5.3-codex model 'isn't available on the API yet', undercutting full SDK support for Codex itself.
